headings.quote: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
headings.note: The book calls its author “the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem” (1:1) and “king over Israel in Jerusalem” (1:12), but never gives his name, so no ruler is listed. Identifying him as Solomon is a reading, not the text.

david-rut-4-17.name: David
david-rut-4-17.title: King of Judah, then of all Israel
